notes.manas-2010:p1656:b001:l001: Moon’s eye and sun’s face are retained personifying images; the dust/battle darkness does not establish a dated eclipse.
notes.manas-2010:p1656:b001:l017: Түтүн, literally hearth/smoke, is the household for this one-warrior levy;18 салым is the levy.
notes.manas-2010:p1656:b001:l019: Каканчын retained as the epic imperial designation Kakan-Chin, not assigned a new modern ethnic identity.
notes.manas-2010:p1656:b001:l021: The printed repetition түрдүү-түрдүү is retained as every, every kind.
notes.manas-2010:p1656:b001:l028: Коштоп алган буудан жок denies an accompanying spare mount, not his present Sarala.
notes.manas-2010:p1656:b001:l034: Binding at the waist is first aid for Almambet’s wounds in context, not merely putting on a belt.
notes.manas-2010:p1656:b001:l038: Кызырдуу invokes Kydyr’s favor; көк жал blue-maned is the heroic wolf epithet, not literal human hair color.
notes.manas-2010:p1656:b001:l040: Printed кырк эки гана is exactly only forty-two, not corrected to forty-two thousand or omitted despite the huge forces elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p1656:b001:l041: It-Ölbös is the named desert; no modern geographical identification asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1657:b001:l004: The deep dug pit is retained without inventing who dug it or assigning it to a particular fortification.
notes.manas-2010:p1657:b001:l005: Кырк сан кол provisionally forty vast hosts; сан has both innumerable-host and myriad numerical usages. No precise400000 census asserted; distinct from explicit6000 next row.
notes.manas-2010:p1657:b001:l008: The white-bearded elder epithet is printed for Kongurbay, retained despite potentially differing age characterizations.
notes.manas-2010:p1657:b001:l012: Коок is the punitive hide head-covering, not a gourd: source glossary1839:22 and earlier1499:29. The mechanism is not expanded.
notes.manas-2010:p1657:b001:l020: Кызыталак is the source’s harsh divorce-of-a-daughter curse used as an expletive modifying life. Literal daughter-divorced preserves the culturally specific insult, not a claim about an actual daughter’s marital status.
notes.manas-2010:p1657:b001:l022: Турнадай crane-like comparison rendered slender as a crane; no unnamed crane character.
notes.manas-2010:p1657:b001:l029: Ээр белдей is the saddle-shaped ridge comparison. Sarala braces there in30–31; action not transformed into a new fall.
notes.manas-2010:p1657:b001:l031: Өлгөндө араң is near-death/extreme-effort phrasing; the horse continues traveling and fighting, so not reported as already dead.
notes.manas-2010:p1657:b001:l034: Уй куймулчак cow-rumped is retained as the horse’s physical epithet rather than normalized to generic strong.
notes.manas-2010:p1657:b001:l042: Даңкан clods/debris here mixes with stones and whistles above the rider over the page boundary. Exact soil composition unasserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1658:b001:l005: Чаткаякка in the horse-tail description provisionally between the hind legs; the tail lashes, not a human whip.
notes.manas-2010:p1658:b001:l014: Louse-sized and thumb-sized childhood comparisons in14–15 retained; not precise physical measurements or different ages supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1658:b001:l017: Кынап жүрөт provisionally presses onward under exertion, in the context of the horse bathed in blood; not a precise gait identification.
notes.manas-2010:p1658:b001:l025: Ninety days and nine wounds retained exactly, distinct from later seventy days/seven wounds and seven days/seventy wounds.
notes.manas-2010:p1658:b001:l029: Урдуу rendered radiant, following Yudakhin урдуу=нурдуу at https://el-sozduk.kg/урдуу/; not Urdu as a language/ethnicity.
notes.manas-2010:p1658:b001:l033: Себеп is explicitly the medicine name; retained as Sebep, not identified with a modern drug or plant. Earlier recovered draft translated the name Remedy; corrected for named-item fidelity.
notes.manas-2010:p1658:b001:l034: Аяш is the relationship to her husband’s close friend; dear companion is concise English, not a biological sibling claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1658:b001:l036: Strong-backed Beijing preserves the physical image of its might/defensibility without inventing a specific wall.
notes.manas-2010:p1658:b001:l038: Бейпай contextual misery/distress is provisional; not emended to the different word бейжай appearing40.
notes.manas-2010:p1659:b001:l001: Умачтай көз ачылуу is eyes opening fully/clearly; not a claim that the medicine’s ingredient is porridge.
notes.manas-2010:p1659:b001:l003: Whip-length tears are the literal hyperbole, not an actual measured stream.
notes.manas-2010:p1659:b001:l013: Printed Эбеп explicitly names a medicine; retained Ebep, distinct from Sebep on the next row. No botanical identity or modern therapeutic claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1659:b001:l014: Printed Себеп is the second named medicine; retained Sebep rather than replacing its name with Remedy.
notes.manas-2010:p1659:b001:l016: Two thumb-tip-sized portions retained; the poem’s remedy episode is not a tested dosage or medical advice.
notes.manas-2010:p1659:b001:l017: Көйкашка renowned champion, following established Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/koy-12/; not shameless.
notes.manas-2010:p1659:b001:l025: Black horses turning red is retained beside the battle narrative; blood is likely contextual but not supplied as an explicit cause on these two rows.
notes.manas-2010:p1660:b001:l003: Trick riders and state-maintained champions are the attackers beheading fallen riders in2–5; not a declaration that every fallen rider was a trick rider.
notes.manas-2010:p1660:b001:l013: Saddles/saddlecloths hanging under bellies belongs to riderless/spare mounts led14; no saddle hardware repair invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1660:b001:l026: Каным is morphologically my khan; paired Chubak/Almambet invocation understood collectively as my khans, a provisional number accommodation.
notes.manas-2010:p1660:b001:l031: Бууданың transfers the peerless-steed epithet to Alma; rendered peerless rather than inventing a second horse named Alma.
notes.manas-2010:p1660:b001:l039: The source contrasts kumys by day and girls by night. No explicit sexual act or ages supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1660:b001:l042: Кырдап provisionally shaping/trimming the cap’s edge. This is the bulletproof black cap, not the Karakalpak people.
notes.manas-2010:p1661:b001:l001: Кошо билип кыргызды retained literally knowing the Kyrgyz together; the precise social/political force in this reminiscence remains provisional. No replacement with ruling the Kyrgyz without a confirming witness.
notes.manas-2010:p1661:b001:l003: Омбу retained as Ombu, not silently modernized to Omsk without source identification.
notes.manas-2010:p1661:b001:l005: Меке is recognizable, but дылда кылымды is not securely interpreted in the raiding sequence. Earlier similar дылда gap1329:31 remains unresolved. No invented place-name Dyl da or guessed gold-world paraphrase counted as translation. Completion-first first pass: Low-confidence approximate rendering for “Меке дылда кылымды”; nearest corpus parallel was “Чек чыгарбай кылымды”.
notes.manas-2010:p1661:b001:l009: 6000jamby silver ingots and1000otter pelts retained; ingot weights unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p1661:b001:l013: Жая is the horse-rump meat cut, not generic meat or a human body part.
notes.manas-2010:p1661:b001:l015: Жаң-жуң could be the governor-general’s title or a name; provisional title in the boast, not a new identified person.
notes.manas-2010:p1661:b001:l016: Зулпукор is the named blade Zulpuqor, retained rather than reduced to a generic keen sword. The following verse is unresolved separately.
notes.manas-2010:p1661:b001:l017: Restored after primary verification: raw Коолошүп, PDF Коолошуп interpreted көөлөшүп, battle with weapons. Yudakhin көөлөш-II https://el-sozduk.kg/көө/ lines1060–1063 gives exact red spear/sharp steel fighting boast and жөөлөш parallel. Same edition1741:21–26 has black-steel Zulpuqor/көөлөшөрмүн/world/жөөлөш;1808:3–7 independently repeats spear/Zulpuqor/көөлөш/world/жөөлөш. All relevant page images inspected. Here16 names black-steel Zulpuqor and18–19 world/жөөлөш; these convergent primary parallels justify defective vowel reading, not mere contextual guessing. Кетем go/begin auxiliary and second-person дечү элең retained. Raw/SHA/bbox unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1661:b001:l024: Eighteen thousand worlds is the formula’s number, not an astronomical claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1661:b001:l033: Кызыталак retains the harsh daughter-divorced curse, directed at the companion addressed; not omitted because the speaker praises courage elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p1662:b001:l006: The text names Gabriel as soul-taker; not harmonized to Azrael or another doctrinal attribution.
notes.manas-2010:p1662:b001:l007: Беш колун literally five hands is understood idiomatically as the hand’s five fingers; exact supernatural anatomy is not independently established.
notes.manas-2010:p1662:b001:l024: Токонаалат is condemnation/disgrace, not a person’s name. The hanging-on-neck image continues25.
notes.manas-2010:p1662:b001:l026: If what is said is true explicitly qualifies the speaker’s afterlife argument. Retained along with black-donkey imagery30; not stated as translator’s belief.
notes.manas-2010:p1663:b001:l004: Кыялында кырк чоро is compressed; followed their own whims is provisional within the imagined survivors’ accusation, not an independent factual verdict.
notes.manas-2010:p1663:b001:l010: Эшен is the Muslim religious teacher/Sufi elder title; seven teachers and seven positions retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1663:b001:l020: The narrator’s direct address and assertion of no regret remain verse; not editorialized.
notes.manas-2010:p1663:b001:l021: PDF prints Ыстам. Interpreted as minimal л/т error for Ыслам from the surrounding Islamic battle cry and many exact repetitions. Raw retained, emendation disclosed.
notes.manas-2010:p1663:b001:l034: Ылама/Чоң Ылама is Lama/Great Lama, the Kalmyk religious designation; source glossary1844:2 explains Ылама as chief teacher. Preserved title rather than unverified personal name Ylama.
notes.manas-2010:p1663:b001:l039: Twin champions is Ajybai’s affection for Almambet/Chubak, not biological twinship.
notes.manas-2010:p1663:b001:l041: Fainting then darting eyes/feet does not establish death; later rescue retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l003: Alake rides ahead and nearby5, both printed placements retained without an invented battle map.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l012: The source shifts from Almambet to Chubak here; he too14 marks Chubak’s additional charge.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l016: Ылама/Чоң Ылама is Lama/Great Lama, the Kalmyk religious designation; source glossary1844:2 explains Ылама as chief teacher. Preserved title rather than unverified personal name Ylama.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l022: Hemp belt edge22 and right shoulder23 are both retained aiming phrases; not collapsed to a single anatomically reconciled entry point.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l025: Муштап in the spear context means striking/thrusting, not an unarmed punch. The exact passage through the victim is not expanded.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l027: Ылама/Чоң Ылама is Lama/Great Lama, the Kalmyk religious designation; source glossary1844:2 explains Ылама as chief teacher. Preserved title rather than unverified personal name Ylama.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l033: Мөндүлөп is crying мөндү, Come!, per source glossary1841:4–6; not an untranslated battle cry.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l034: Айласы кетип concerns loss of recourse/resourcefulness rather than physical strength alone; context is Ylama dislodged from his saddle.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l037: Ойкума is the named sword Oykuma, identified among the named blades in the source at1504–1523; restored rather than generic fearsome sword.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l038: Ылама/Чоң Ылама is Lama/Great Lama, the Kalmyk religious designation; source glossary1844:2 explains Ылама as chief teacher. Preserved title rather than unverified personal name Ylama.
notes.manas-2010:p1664:b001:l039: Printed Мөндүрдөй каны бөгүлдү has recognizable blood/hail but бөгүлдү conflicts with the expected pouring idiom. Next41 has төгүлдү. No independent witness confirms emending this verse’s бөгүлдү to төгүлдү; entire verse excluded until resolved. Completion-first first pass: Best-effort rendering from a close formulaic parallel; retain for specialist review because the source was previously unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p1665:b001:l007: Twelve at once retained; no attempted casualty reconciliation.
notes.manas-2010:p1665:b001:l011: Feedbag comparison and slinging Ajybai behind the rider retained; the rescued man is not identified as dead.
notes.manas-2010:p1665:b001:l014: Golden forelock and tasseled belt preserve equipment/epithet imagery; not proof of hair literally made of gold.
notes.manas-2010:p1665:b001:l022: Калча is Kongurbay’s grim-faced/fierce epithet, following Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/калча/, not a distinct assailant.
notes.manas-2010:p1665:b001:l024: Көмө коюп contextual knocking the mounted Kongurbay down is supported by flying from Algara26–27, not burial.
notes.manas-2010:p1665:b001:l029: The narrator’s I do not know is retained as a verse, not excluded as an annotation.
notes.manas-2010:p1665:b001:l030: Балтай versus earlier Акбалтай retained as the printed short form of Chubak’s father.
notes.manas-2010:p1666:b001:l001: A hulking mountain is the metaphor for the marksman hiding among grass; not inserted as a new mountain place-name.
notes.manas-2010:p1666:b001:l007: Parenthetical7–8 are narrated action, not editorial notes; both counted as verse rows.
notes.manas-2010:p1666:b001:l011: Green clothing and changing appearance preserve the camouflaging/sorcery description; no modern equipment invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1666:b001:l014: Grease from thumb and blood from nails are source hyperbolic bodily images; not omitted or changed to gun lubricant instructions.
notes.manas-2010:p1666:b001:l019: Маша here is the ready gun trigger, distinct from craft/skill usage elsewhere;20 таза the best/master in shooting, not bald.
notes.manas-2010:p1666:b001:l026: Очогор is matchlock firearm; shot supplied by metonymy because it strikes the body. Not flintlock.
notes.manas-2010:p1666:b001:l032: Printed coward characterization is retained despite heroism elsewhere; not toned down to merely wounded.
notes.manas-2010:p1666:b001:l034: Бийөнгө is not securely identified. Occurrences with strikes to the head elsewhere rule out confidently reading it as intestine/gut, but do not establish a particular projectile. Recovered draft gut removed; no generic bullet guess counted. Completion-first first pass: Low-confidence approximate rendering for “Ошондо бийөнгө тийип белине,”; nearest corpus parallel was “Ошондо он жетиде келинчек”.
notes.manas-2010:p1666:b001:l039: Аркалуу indicates powerful/protectively backed in the heroic horse epithet, provisionally supernaturally supported; not just a pack-horse.
notes.manas-2010:p1667:b001:l005: Both men struck together in one shot retained, not corrected for physical likelihood.
notes.manas-2010:p1667:b001:l022: Bow/arrows and gun/bullets alternate explicitly; no harmonizing all weapons to rifles.
notes.manas-2010:p1667:b001:l027: 1000,100,50,40shots retained in sequence, including repeated painted short gun25/33; no interpolation of omitted firearms.
notes.manas-2010:p1667:b001:l037: Төлгөчүдөй provisionally like the diviner; does not identify an additional named Tölgochu hero.
notes.manas-2010:p1668:b001:l004: Akzholtoy’s death repeats after1667:41–42; both retained, not deduplicated.
notes.manas-2010:p1668:b001:l018: Бадышалап is shouting the sovereign-title in battle; source then cries Manas. Not a new king named Badysha.
notes.manas-2010:p1668:b001:l031: Forty companions return as support after the previous deaths and Alma’s solitude; this narrative inconsistency is preserved rather than reduced to surviving companions.
notes.manas-2010:p1668:b001:l034: Avenging Chubak is printed although Chubak fled wounded; not a claim that this line independently establishes his death.
notes.manas-2010:p1668:b001:l038: Каны understood khan in the capture context, not blood; the collective referent remains unexpressed in the source.
notes.manas-2010:p1669:b001:l012: Зер goldwork/ornament rendered jewels alongside gold; does not establish particular gemstones.
notes.manas-2010:p1669:b001:l028: Таш сайынган is rank-button headgear, established dictionary/edition usage; not stone-worship.
notes.manas-2010:p1669:b001:l030: Jangjung retained as designation in a death list; no harmonization with prior living figures sharing the title.
notes.manas-2010:p1669:b001:l031: Кара балбан retained as hero Kara the champion, rather than conflating automatically with Ezkara.
notes.manas-2010:p1670:b001:l005: The compressed proverb contrasts confidence/secrets and betrayal; the repeated dangerous is retained without adding an unstated conditional.
notes.manas-2010:p1670:b001:l009: Ertysh/Irtysh is the printed river; no modern campaign chronology inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1670:b001:l019: Татытып is causative, making someone taste; speaker Kongurbay invokes his former hospitality to Almambet. Restored the giver rather than having an ambiguous subject taste salt.
notes.manas-2010:p1670:b001:l020: Кызымды is singular my daughter, not daughters. The capture/plunder is Kongurbay’s accusation; retained without identifying an unexpressed daughter.
notes.manas-2010:p1670:b001:l031: Put captive Manas to stud is the explicit threat of sexual coercion expressed through a stallion metaphor. It is the enemy’s proposal, not an accomplished event.
notes.manas-2010:p1670:b001:l032: The projected boy is to be made khan of Beijing; no omission of this outcome because the threat is abusive.
notes.manas-2010:p1670:b001:l042: Night death-spirit renders жалаңгыч as the predatory supernatural image; no identified deity supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1671:b001:l022: Once every seven steps is retained exactly as the threatened torment; not a procedural expansion.
notes.manas-2010:p1671:b001:l023: Үшүнтүп means thus, doing this (үшүнт < ушуну эт), verified Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/үш/. Refers back to the preceding torment; not a conjectural freezing/chilling verb.
notes.manas-2010:p1671:b001:l033: Манжуу here labels the pursued Kongurbay as Manchu; no substitution of the unrelated figure Manzhuu.
notes.manas-2010:p1671:b001:l039: Убарлашым rendered companion in suffering, the relationship to Sarala; not an unknown person’s name.
notes.manas-2010:p1672:b001:l005: Кол denotes horse forelegs in this passage; not human hands.
notes.manas-2010:p1672:b001:l015: Alternating downhill advantage Algara/uphill gain Sarala is preserved in three repeated sets.
notes.manas-2010:p1672:b001:l026: Буурусун is the traditional wooden plow, not a military machine.
notes.manas-2010:p1672:b001:l031: The compressed30–32 turns toward the pursued Kalcha: dative marking is absent. English leaves the named target as a detached phrase and the pursuer as he in32;33–37 clearly make Almambet the attacker. No reversal of pursuer asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1672:b001:l036: Далынын күзгүсү means thin part of shoulder blade, explicitly Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/күзгү/; not an armor mirror assumed from the isolated noun.
notes.manas-2010:p1672:b001:l042: Түпкүч round pot-stand ring; exact bent-in-arc idiom confirmed Yudakhin and craft dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/түпкүч/. The spear bends but does not break41.
notes.manas-2010:p1673:b001:l006: Кайдалап is calling where are they, not just a troop movement. Manchu hosts and troops both retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1673:b001:l007: Айласы кетип is loss of recourse, not necessarily strength. He is groping at the crupper after the spear blow.
notes.manas-2010:p1673:b001:l011: Эстесе сөзү кеч болуп rendered literally thought/words too late; precise idiomatic nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p1673:b001:l014: Two eyes becoming four is expectant eagerness, retained as a figurative image, not anatomical transformation.
notes.manas-2010:p1673:b001:l020: Кечил has monk and Kalmyk usages in the glossary1839; khan of monks is a provisional literal epithet rather than asserting every soldier’s monastic status.
notes.manas-2010:p1673:b001:l030: Bereaved-wife simile applied to Almambet is printed; not changed to a bereaved man for gender agreement.
notes.manas-2010:p1673:b001:l033: Reviving deadened life is figurative rescue in this scene, not evidence Almambet has already died and been resurrected.
notes.manas-2010:p1673:b001:l039: Half a bowshot is the relative distance unit; no conversion to meters without a fixed measure.
notes.manas-2010:p1674:b001:l002: Кыйкыртып is causative: Ajybai makes Alake cry out, following the bodily agitation and leading-away at1673:28–33. Preserved rather than silently rewriting as Ajybai shouting. Exact manner of taking him alongside remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p1674:b001:l010: Algara’s wings are explicit and retained literally; not rationalized as speed alone.
notes.manas-2010:p1674:b001:l030: Карагандан как жалгыз provisionally utterly alone among those he might look to; the precise compressed relation remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1674:b001:l035: Kambar is the explicitly named comparison, not silently identified as a particular historical figure.
notes.manas-2010:p1674:b001:l038: The dug road and кымбат costly/precious retained literally; contextual hazard of the trap is clear, but exact lexical nuance of costly road remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p1674:b001:l041: Белем gives narrator’s recollective/questioning emphasis. The road is the place of the surrounding, not the attacking subject.
notes.manas-2010:p1675:b001:l005: Goose/crag, crow/mountain parallels retained; not resolved into a modern geographic proverb.
notes.manas-2010:p1675:b001:l007: Manas as absent mountain/support explicitly follows the crag image; not a mountain named Manas substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1675:b001:l015: Stirring stars retained as the companions’ cosmic bond image; next-world friendship16 not reduced to ordinary friendship.
notes.manas-2010:p1675:b001:l027: Seven days/seventy wounds deliberately differs from1658:25–27ninety/nine and1659:20–21seventy/seven. No harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1675:b001:l030: Argynkan’s unfortunate son identifies Ajybai;32 switches to Azizkan’s young hawk Almambet. The source shifts actors without a connective explanation; retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1675:b001:l037: Seven thousand smashed down retained as the explicit number.

word_counts.method: Python alphabetic words, internal apostrophes/hyphens: [^\W\d_]+(?:[’'-][^\W\d_]+)*; translated verse only, notes and editorial text excluded.
